note: What a server sends to put a minion-like unit on the field, such as a ward. The header names the unit that put it there.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The name the new unit answers to.

fields.name: node
fields.note: Which network node the unit belongs to.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where it stands, along one ground axis.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where it stands, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: clone
fields.note: The unit it copies, or zero.

fields.name: flags

bits.name: team
bits.note: Which side, as a team number.

bits.name: ignoreCollision
bits.note: Set where it does not block the way.

bits.name: ward
bits.note: Set where it is a ward.

bits.name: laneMinion
bits.note: Set where it is a lane minion.

bits.name: bot
bits.note: Set where it is driven by the client's own decisions.

bits.name: targetable
bits.note: Set where it can be aimed at.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.note: What sort of unit it is.

fields.name: targetableToTeam
fields.note: Which sides can aim at it, as a set of bits.

fields.name: visibilitySize
fields.note: How large it counts as for sight.

fields.name: name
fields.note: Its name, padded with zero bytes.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The name the client loads its art under, padded with zero bytes.

fields.name: onlyVisibleTo
fields.note: The unit that alone can see it, or zero.

revisions.note: A client deletes any object holding the new unit's id first, and logs and does nothing more where it cannot make the unit. owner is only who gets the gold the unit earns; clone, where nonzero, is copied, state and inventory; onlyVisibleTo, zero or unknown, restricts nothing.
